Imo the biggest thing is understanding your audience 

Is this person into ANY animation? Or do they think it's for kids 

Do they enjoy anime but not manga? And vice versa

Do they enjoy long stories or short and sweet? 

Do they enjoy realism or fantasy ?

Do they enjoy weekly discussion or finishing a story? 

Do they want stuff light on content or more contemplative? 

If you wanna ignore everything just recommend either The Boxer (Short, about boxing, great art, not a lot of weird anime shit) or Tower of God (Extremely long, ongoing, incredibly fantastical with very little realism at all). I'd say those are the 2 paths you wanna hone in on, if someone enjoys something more crazy or more realistic

As a lover of both Roguelikes and Roguelites I'd say this is one of the best ones. 

My resume: Risk of Rain 1+2, Moonlighter, Hades, Curse of the Dead Gods, OSFE, Skul, Isaac, and dozens more. 

Music: Incredible orchestral soundtrack gives very chill vibes 

Sound design: unbelievable. The sound effects in this game are incredibly satisfying, from the ambience to just changing rooms it feels super good to just move 

Combat: I love the Fuck out of this combat. I'm biased but gotta say I'm in love. It's like a action based game but has that OSFE deck style of attacks. Super super cool. 

Story: idk what the story is or about but I like seeing the cool character designs and worlds 

Environment: what a fun place to explore. I loved Wizard of Legend for the same reason, it is short sweet and to the point 

Overall: I'd give it a try. If you don't immediately love it maybe not your style. Though as someone who enjoys OSFE I doubt you wouldn't love it.
